input_schema.path: <win-home>/inbox-triage-<yyyymmdd>/send-<id>.txt, one batch of up to reply_batch_max files

checklist.box: The brief names every file of the batch and each file's one thread URL
checklist.proof: grep count of `Approval file:` in the rendered brief equals the batch size, and so does `Thread URL:`.

checklist.box: Ledger has no `RP-SENT` for this sha256 and thread
checklist.proof: `jq` over `ledger.jsonl` returns zero rows (the exactly-once check).

checklist.box: The pane shows the id, recipient, text and sha256 of every reply, then RP-AWAITING-CONFIRM batch <batch-id>
